• I don't charge by the hour because it doesn't reward being good at my job (static-only cartographer). "You're not paying for the two hours it took me to do the map, you're paying for the years it took me to learn how to do that in two hours."
• I recommend flat-rate contracts with X free revisions, subject to per-revision fee of Y after the cap's met. Add strict payment dates and a deposit of at least 25%.
